csv_project_name: A/E For Memorial Hall Facility Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The Apache Diabetes Wellness Center is requesting proposals (RFP) from Architectural and Engineering (A/E) firms licensed in the State of Arizona to provide design services for a complete renovation of the Memorial Hall Facility that is approximately 13,000 square feet. Memorial Hall is located in Whiteriver, AZ. Renovation work is being requested to upgrade the existing building with new classrooms, childcare area, MEP upgrades, kitchen upgrades, and office space.
